name: deloen
description: Writing skills that help your AI model write clear, natural emails, articles, website copy and more.

interface.longDescription: Writing skills that help your AI model write clear, natural emails, articles, website copy and more. Describe what you need or provide a draft to revise while preserving its meaning and facts. Deloen provides guidance tailored to your request, and your AI model produces the finished writing. You need a Deloen account to connect.
defaultPrompt: Use Deloen to write a clear, natural email.
Use Deloen to improve my draft while keeping its meaning.
Use Deloen to write website copy from the facts I provide.

positive.prompt: Call list_writing_options using the Deloen plugin.
positive.expected_behavior: List the available writing types and skills without requiring a saved profile.

positive.prompt: Write a short email thanking Sam for the project update. Make my AI model write like a human.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare relevant guidance and let the host return the finished email. Treat the generic human-writing request as natural style, not named-writer imitation.

positive.description: Revise a supplied draft without changing facts
positive.prompt: Make this draft calmer, preserving every fact: The files were late. Please send the corrected files tomorrow. Supply the draft as draft_to_transform.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the draft as source text to transform. Return a calmer final message through the host without changing the late files or tomorrow deadline.

positive.description: Write website copy from supplied facts
positive.prompt: Write a short website paragraph for an appointment tool that shares availability and prevents double bookings. Use website_page.
positive.expected_behavior: Use website_page and return guidance for useful website copy based on the supplied facts; the host writes the paragraph without inventing claims.

positive.prompt: Write a short article explaining how to make AI writing more natural, with practical examples. Use writingGoal seo and formatOverride seo_article.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the SEO goal and article format, then let the host write the article. Do not invent research citations or results.

negative.description: Missing material delivery information requires clarification
negative.prompt: Use Deloen to tell a customer delivery is delayed and give them the new delivery date.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the new delivery date before drafting. Do not invent a date, reason or guarantee. After the user answers, continue with the original request and clarification answer.

negative.prompt: Use Deloen to delete my account or cancel my subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not perform or claim account deletion or cancellation. Deloen exposes read-only writing tools, with no account or billing mutation tools.

negative.description: Protected writing features require authorized access
negative.prompt: Use Deloen with a disconnected or unentitled account.
negative.expected_behavior: Scenario: disconnect before invoking a protected tool, or connect a verified test account without paid or complimentary access. Require authentication for a disconnected account. Allow only shared catalog discovery for an authenticated unentitled account; deny writing and private preference access with a neutral error. Do not expose another account or market an upgrade in tool output.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not process payments, sell products or change subscriptions in ChatGPT. Writing features require a Deloen subscription purchased separately on deloen.com or owner-granted complimentary access. AI model subscriptions are separate.

publication.release_notes: Initial public Deloen submission package: authenticated remote MCP connection on deloen.com, shared writing-options discovery, natural and structured writing preparation, source-preserving revision, material-fact clarifications, and account-scoped writing preferences. Includes Deloen branding and public support, privacy and terms links. Writing and private preferences require current paid or complimentary access.
